milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the hay_block stack and face it to demonstrate they have located it. The hay_block center is at spawn-relative (8, 1, 8). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the hay blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the bee_nest and face it. The bee_nest is at spawn-relative (-7, 3, -5) attached to the oak tree at height 3. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the bee_nest on the tree.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a yellow_bed results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must craft yellow_dye from dandelions, craft a white_bed from wool+planks, then combine white_bed+yellow_dye to get a yellow_bed. The crafted yellow_bed (min_count=1) in inventory confirms task completion. This item is not in the starting inventory so any presence confirms crafting success.
